question: 真实 issue(PlasmaControl/DESC #1940,已由 PR #1943 修复):对一个完全对称的磁平衡,几何量 λ 的磁通面平均物理上应当恒等于零;用户发现 `surface_averages` 手算确实给出零(atol=1e-16),而 `plot_fsa` 绘出的曲线却呈非零线性趋势。该现象最可能的根因是?

options.A: `plot_fsa` 与 `surface_averages` 使用了不一致的加权/节点约定(如 √g 权重或坐标系约定),而物理正确的 λ 通面平均在对称平衡下必须为零
options.B: 对称平衡本身出了问题
options.C: λ 的通面平均本来就不需要为零
options.D: 是显示器渲染错误,与算法无关

metadata.notes: 通面平均 ⟨f⟩=∮f dl/B / ∮dl/B;对称平衡下 ⟨λ⟩≡0 是解析判据

question_en: [Real issue: PlasmaControl/DESC #1940, fixed by PR #1943] For a fully symmetric magnetic equilibrium, the flux-surface average of the geometric quantity lambda must vanish identically. The user found that a manual computation via `surface_averages` indeed returns zero (atol=1e-16), yet `plot_fsa` plots a nonzero, linear-looking trend. What is the most likely root cause?

options_en.A: `plot_fsa` and `surface_averages` use inconsistent weighting/node conventions (e.g. sqrt(g) weight or coordinate convention), while the physically correct lambda flux-surface average must be zero for a symmetric equilibrium
options_en.B: The symmetric equilibrium itself is wrong
options_en.C: The lambda flux-surface average need not be zero anyway
options_en.D: It is a display-rendering artifact, unrelated to the algorithm

question: 真实 issue(PlasmaControl/DESC #1879,已由 PR #1880 修复):`to_sfl` 例程把 DESC 平衡转换到直线场坐标(PEST)时忽略了什么关键事实,导致'基函数在 PEST 坐标下收敛性受损,并可能出现病态求逆'?

options.A: 同一谱基在不同坐标系下只在各自特定的节点集上离散正交——FourierZernike 基在 DESC 坐标与直线场坐标下的正交节点集不同
options.B: 直线场坐标不存在磁面
options.C: Zernike 多项式不能用于环向几何
options.D: 转换时网格数必须减半

metadata.notes: 谱基离散正交性依赖坐标系的节点集——谱方法的核心细节

question_en: [Real issue: PlasmaControl/DESC #1879, fixed by PR #1880] The `to_sfl` routine, which converts a DESC equilibrium to straight-field-line (PEST) coordinates, overlooked a key fact, causing the basis to 'handicap the convergence in PEST coordinates' and 'potentially lead to numerical issues with ill-conditioned inversions'. What fact was overlooked?

options_en.A: A spectral basis is (discretely) orthogonal on a different node set for each coordinate system — the FourierZernike basis in DESC coordinates and in straight-field-line coordinates have different orthogonal node sets
options_en.B: Straight field lines do not exist on flux surfaces
options_en.C: Zernike polynomials cannot be used in toroidal geometry
options_en.D: The number of grid nodes must be halved in the conversion

question: 真实 issue(openmc-dev/openmc #1472):30 cm 铁球(天然 Fe,1 g/cm³),球心 55 MeV 各向同性中子源,两代码中子数据同为 FENDL-3,但光子数据不同(OpenMC 用 ENDF/B-VII.1,MCNP 用 ENDF/B-VI)。中子-光子耦合输运下 OpenMC 光子通量系统性偏高,最大比值 1.6;而纯光子源对照组两代码一致(7% 内)。这组对照最能说明什么?

options.A: 差异主要来自中子→光子的产生通道(截面/产额数据或实现),而不是光子输运本身——纯光子对照一致排除了光子输运嫌疑
options.B: OpenMC 的光子输运有系统性 bug

metadata.notes: 对照实验隔离嫌疑变量是 V&V 的核心方法论

question_en: [Real issue: openmc-dev/openmc #1472] A benchmark of coupled neutron-photon transport: 30 cm iron sphere (natural Fe, 1 g/cm^3), 55 MeV isotropic neutron source at the center, photon cell flux tally. Neutron data is FENDL-3 in both codes, but photon data differs (OpenMC uses ENDF/B-VII.1, MCNP uses ENDF/B-VI). OpenMC photon fluxes are systematically higher than MCNP, with a maximum ratio of 1.6; with a photon-only source, the two codes agree within 7%. What does this control comparison best demonstrate?

options_en.A: The difference mainly comes from the neutron-to-photon production channel (cross-section/yield data or implementation), not photon transport itself — the photon-only control agreement rules out photon transport as the suspect
options_en.B: OpenMC photon transport has a systematic bug
options_en.C: MCNP's neutron cross sections are wrong

question: 真实 issue(openmc-dev/openmc #2418):同一模型中使用两个网格过滤器(一个覆盖全模型的粗网格 flux 计数;一个部件上的细网格氚增殖计数)导致模拟在同一批次无限挂起、不报错;几何在 debug 模式下无重叠错误,移除网格计数后模拟正常收敛。该现象对调试的启示是?

options.A: 挂起未必源于几何重叠——过滤器/计数实现(网格-几何求交、内存或循环逻辑)也能造成静默挂起;用'移除法'逐步隔离子系统是定位手段
options.C: 网格过滤器不能与 cell 过滤器同用(物理不允许)

metadata.notes: debug 方法学:二分/移除隔离法

question_en: [Real issue: openmc-dev/openmc #2418] Using two mesh filters in one model (a coarse mesh covering the whole model with a flux score; a finer mesh on one component with a cell filter and a tritium transmutation score) caused the simulation to hang indefinitely in the same batch with no error raised. Geometry debug mode showed no overlaps; removing the mesh tallies restored normal convergence. What is the debugging lesson?

options_en.A: Hangs are not necessarily caused by geometry overlaps — filter/tally implementation (mesh-geometry intersection, memory, or loop logic) can also cause silent hangs; the 'removal method' of incrementally isolating subsystems is the way to locate them
options_en.B: It must be a geometry error
options_en.C: Mesh filters physically cannot be combined with cell filters
options_en.D: Only global meshes can be used

question: 真实 issue(BLAST-WarpX/warpx #4038,以 'not planned' 关闭):在 RZ 几何下选择 PSATD 电磁求解器时报错 'PEC boundary not implemented for PSATD, yet',且其他求解器也不可用,只有 Yee 求解器在 RZ 几何可用。该 issue 反映的工程现实是?

options.A: 谱求解器(PSATD)的边界条件实现与几何强耦合,RZ 下的 PEC 边界尚未实现是已知的未覆盖场景;当前可行路径是用 Yee 求解器
options.B: PSATD 在所有几何下都支持 PEC
options.C: Yee 求解器不能在 RZ 用
options.D: 该报错说明输入文件语法错误

metadata.notes: 求解器×几何×边界的支持矩阵是实际工程约束

question_en: [Real issue: BLAST-WarpX/warpx #4038, closed as 'not planned'] With `rz` geometry and the PSATD electromagnetic solver, the code aborts with 'PEC boundary not implemented for PSATD, yet'; the other solver options also fail, and only the Yee solver works for `rz` geometry. What engineering reality does this issue reflect?

options_en.A: Spectral-solver (PSATD) boundary-condition implementations are strongly coupled to geometry; PEC boundary in RZ is an unimplemented known gap — the viable path today is the Yee solver
options_en.B: PSATD supports PEC in all geometries
options_en.C: Yee cannot be used in RZ
options_en.D: The error means the input file has a syntax error

question: 真实 issue(google-deepmind/torax #2284):多 tick 模拟中由安全因子拟合(safety_factor_fit)计算的 q_min 出现非物理负值。q(安全因子)物理上必须为正,拟合曲线在非单调/外推区间可能产生负值。正确的工程处置是?

options.A: 对拟合施加物理约束(如单调性/正性限制)或检测并拒绝非物理区间,而不是直接输出负 q
options.C: 负 q 说明等离子体破裂,无需处理
options.D: 只需把结果取绝对值后使用即可,无需改拟合

metadata.notes: 物理约束拟合 vs 裸多项式拟合

question_en: [Real issue: google-deepmind/torax #2284] In multi-tick simulations, q_min computed from the safety-factor fit (safety_factor_fit) takes unphysical negative values. The safety factor q must be physically positive, but the fitted curve can go negative in non-monotonic/extrapolated regions. What is the correct engineering response?

options_en.A: Impose physical constraints on the fit (monotonicity/positivity limits) or detect and reject unphysical regions, rather than emitting negative q directly
options_en.B: q is allowed to be negative
options_en.C: Negative q means disruption; nothing to do
options_en.D: Just take the absolute value and move on without changing the fit

question: 真实 issue(google-deepmind/torax #2145):传给 TGLF 输运模型的默认参数不正确,导致预测的输运系数被系统性偏差。这类'默认值 bug'对科学模拟的危害在于?

options.A: 它不产生报错、静默地改变物理结果——用户在不改任何输入的情况下得到偏差结论;必须靠参考解回归测试/默认参数审计来发现
options.B: 默认值 bug 会立即崩溃,容易发现
options.C: 默认值只影响输出格式

metadata.notes: 静默物理偏差是最危险的 bug 类型;回归测试是防线

question_en: [Real issue: google-deepmind/torax #2145] Incorrect default parameters were passed to the TGLF transport model, systematically biasing the predicted transport coefficients. Why is this class of 'default-value bug' dangerous for scientific simulation?

options_en.A: It fails silently without errors, quietly changing physical results — users get biased conclusions without changing any input; it must be caught by reference-solution regression tests / default-parameter audits
options_en.B: Default-value bugs crash immediately and are easy to find
options_en.C: Default values only affect output format

question: 真实 issue(google-deepmind/torax #2016):从 EQDSK 平衡文件提取的轴上磁场 B0 被错误求值,影响所有派生量(q 剖面、β、归一化电流等)。对该类'输入解析错误',最有效的防线是?

options.A: 对解析结果做独立复核(与另一解析器/解析公式的对照,如与平衡代码独立计算的 B0 比对)并纳入回归测试
options.B: 只要文件能读入就不会错
options.D: 每次手动检查就行,无需测试

metadata.notes: EQDSK 是平衡交换标准格式,其解析必须可回归

question_en: [Real issue: google-deepmind/torax #2016] The on-axis magnetic field B0 extracted from an EQDSK equilibrium file was computed incorrectly, affecting all derived quantities (q profile, beta, normalized current, etc.). What is the most effective defense against this class of 'input-parsing error'?

options_en.A: Independently verify parsed results (cross-check against another parser or against analytic formulas, e.g. B0 computed independently by an equilibrium code) and put them into regression tests
options_en.B: If the file parses, the values must be right
options_en.C: B0 does not affect downstream quantities
options_en.D: Manual checking each time is enough; no tests needed

question: 真实 issue(google-deepmind/torax #2070):修订电子密度 n_e 的边界条件——改变密度边缘值的施加方式。输运模拟中边缘(台基)边界条件的物理意义是?

options.A: 台基边界值为整个芯部剖面演化提供边界条件,其设定(固定值/梯度/通量)直接决定台基高度并全局影响芯部约束预测
options.B: 边界条件只影响计算速度
options.D: 台基高度与边界条件无关

metadata.notes: 芯部-台基耦合:边界条件是全局预测的关键输入

question_en: [Real issue: google-deepmind/torax #2070] The boundary condition for the electron density n_e was revised, changing how the density edge value is imposed. What is the physical meaning of the edge (pedestal) boundary condition in transport simulation?

options_en.A: The pedestal boundary value provides the boundary condition for the whole core profile evolution; its form (fixed value / gradient / flux) directly sets the pedestal height and globally affects core confinement predictions
options_en.B: Boundary conditions only affect compute speed
options_en.C: The density boundary is unrelated to transport
options_en.D: Pedestal height is independent of boundary conditions

question: 真实 issue(google-deepmind/torax #2146):请求为准线性输运模型增加碰撞率 ν*(collisionality)上限设置,以避免极端区间行为。ν* 在输运物理中的作用是?

options.A: ν* 划分输运区间(香蕉/平台/Pfirsch-Schlüter),决定新古典输运系数的形式;极端 ν* 区间公式可能失效,需要截断/封顶

metadata.notes: ν* 是新古典输运区间划分的核心无量纲数

evidence.cross_source: torax issue #2146 + 新古典输运教科书

question_en: [Real issue: google-deepmind/torax #2146] A request was made for a configurable collisionality (nu*) cap in quasilinear transport models to avoid extreme-regime behavior. What is the role of nu* in transport physics?

options_en.A: nu* divides transport regimes (banana / plateau / Pfirsch-Schlueter), determining the form of neoclassical transport coefficients; formulas may fail in extreme-nu* regimes, so capping/truncation is needed
options_en.C: nu* is unrelated to transport coefficients
options_en.D: The larger nu*, the wider the banana regime

question: 真实 issue(google-deepmind/torax #1864):TGLFNN 与 Angioni-Sauter 输运组合时,_get_v_ExB_shear 发生 JAX tracer 泄漏,腐蚀数值求值。'tracer 泄漏'在可微分编程框架中的含义是?

options.A: JAX 的抽象求值 tracer 逃逸出应有的 jit/grad 上下文,被用于非预期计算路径,导致结果错误或异常;需要隔离 tracer 使用范围
options.B: 是一种内存泄漏,与数值无关

metadata.notes: 可微分物理模拟中的典型工程陷阱

question_en: [Real issue: google-deepmind/torax #1864] Combining TGLFNN with Angioni-Sauter transport caused a JAX tracer leak in `_get_v_ExB_shear`, corrupting numerical evaluation. What does a 'tracer leak' mean in differentiable-programming frameworks?

options_en.A: A JAX abstract-evaluation tracer escapes its intended jit/grad context and gets used on an unintended computation path, causing wrong results or errors; tracer usage must be scoped
options_en.B: It is a memory leak, unrelated to numerics

question: 真实 issue(boutproject/BOUT-dev #3442):'PETSC Laplacian Boundary condition'。椭圆求解器(PETSc Laplacian)边界条件设置错误的直接影响是?

options.A: 势函数/涡量等椭圆反演的解在边界附近失真,可能全局污染流体演化(如 ExB 漂移流场),必须保证边界条件与物理边界类型一致
options.B: 只影响最后一步的输出精度
options.D: 椭圆求解器不需要边界条件

metadata.notes: 椭圆反演对边界条件高度敏感

question_en: [Real issue: boutproject/BOUT-dev #3442, 'PETSC Laplacian Boundary condition'] What is the direct consequence of incorrectly set boundary conditions in an elliptic solver (PETSc Laplacian)?

options_en.A: The elliptic-inverted solution (potential/vorticity) is distorted near the boundary and can globally contaminate the flow evolution (e.g. ExB drift flow); boundary conditions must match the physical boundary type
options_en.B: It only affects the accuracy of the final output step
options_en.D: Elliptic solvers need no boundary conditions

question: 真实 issue(google-deepmind/torax #1938):IMAS core_sources 加载器在粒子源只对离子(无电子源)给出时失败。该 issue 反映的数据接口原则是?

options.A: 标准数据模型(IMAS)的可选字段组合必须被显式处理(缺失≠错误),加载器应对'仅离子源'等合法部分组合有明确语义而非崩溃
options.B: IMAS 不允许只给离子源
options.C: 粒子源必须同时给电子
options.D: 加载器崩溃是正确行为

metadata.notes: 标准接口的健壮性:合法的部分组合必须可用

question_en: [Real issue: google-deepmind/torax #1938] The IMAS core_sources loader fails when particle sources are provided for ions only (no electron source). What data-interface principle does this issue reflect?

options_en.A: Optional-field combinations of a standard data model (IMAS) must be handled explicitly (missing != error); the loader must have clear semantics for legal partial combinations like 'ion-only sources' instead of crashing
options_en.B: IMAS does not allow ion-only sources
options_en.C: Particle sources must always include electrons

question: 综合两个真实 issue(openmc #1472 与 torax #2145)的共同教训:跨代码差异(OpenMC 比 MCNP 高最多 1.6 倍)与错误默认参数导致的系统性偏差,对聚变模拟软件的验证体系的启示是?

options.A: 跨代码基准(cross-code benchmark)+ 参考解回归测试是发现系统性偏差的必要组合;单一自洽测试无法暴露与外部真值的偏差
options.B: 只要单元测试全过,物理结果一定正确

metadata.source: 综合 openmc #1472 与 torax #2145(V&V 方法论)
metadata.notes: 系统偏差的发现依赖外部参照

question_en: [Combined real issues: openmc #1472 and torax #2145] Cross-code differences (OpenMC up to 1.6x higher than MCNP) and systematically biasing wrong default parameters teach a common lesson for fusion simulation software verification. What is it?

options_en.A: Cross-code benchmarks + reference-solution regression tests are the necessary combination to find systematic deviations; self-consistency tests alone cannot expose deviations from external ground truth
options_en.B: If all unit tests pass, the physics must be right
